notes.title: Iron Fisticle Update 1.01 Out Now!
notes.notes:
Good news Fisticle Fans!

We've updated Iron Fisticle to 1.01, fixing bugs, adding a new game mode and rebalancing the difficulty! The full patch notes are avialabe on the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/306700/discussions/0/613948093875801125/]forums[/url], but here are the headline changes:

[b]- Three difficulty levels, each with their own leaderboards[/b]
[b]- New Challenge mode[/b]
[b]- Co-op mode, bosses and bonus game rebalanced[/b]
[b]- Extra window scaling options and full menu controller support[/b]
[b]- All achievements now unlock properly[/b]

Thanks to everyone who has contacted us or contributed to the forum thread with feedback and bug reports, it makes a huge difference.
